newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia June building approvals fall 4.5pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia June building approvals fall 4.5pct.

text.p: Australian dwelling unit building approvals fell a seasonally-adjusted 4.5 percent in June to 11,774 from a revised 12,325 in May, compared with 10,225 in June 1996, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
The bureau said approvals for private sector houses fell 12.8 percent in June.
Economists on average had expected June building approvals to fall 1.5 percent.
